experiments.name: reset-chain measurement
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 9223372036854775807; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4; li.d $r5, -9223372036854775807; li.d $r6, 9223372036854775806' --asm 'xvmod.d $xr0, $xr0, $xr2; xvpickve2gr.d $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Element-0 reset chain; the closure latency is cancelled by the calibration experiment.

experiments.name: vadd.b reset-helper baseline
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 4611686018427387903; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4; li.d $r5, -4611686018427387649; li.d $r6, 4611686018427387648' --asm 'xvadd.b $xr0, $xr0, $xr2; xvpickve2gr.d $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Same helper chain with vadd.b replacing the variable-latency operation.

latencies.notes: Data-dependent. Measured over 8 operand pairs; min 7 cycles at 0/1, max 24 cycles at 4611686018427387903/3. The sample experiment uses the max-latency pair. Latency is derived by subtracting the same closure around vadd.b (calibration experiment).

throughput.notes: Data-dependent. CPI ranges 4.5 to 14 over the same operand pairs; the stored experiment uses 4611686018427387903/3.

notes: Latency model: the vector divider retires 4 quotient bits per cycle on every element width and the slowest lane dominates. lat = 8 when the quotient is 0, 11 when it fits in four bits, otherwise 11 + 1 * floor(bits(quotient)/4); for d elements the quotient is at most 64 bits, so the maximum is 26.99. The remainder path costs one extra cycle in the general case and keeps the same extremes pattern, reaching 26.99. Measured with a calibrated reset chain (closure 9 cycles) on the maximum-latency operand pair; 1000-unroll slope method.
